page.title: Public Record | Fractal Media Infrastructure
page.description: A dated public record for Fractal Media Infrastructure, collecting policy, research, software, public-code, identity, and education signals in one place.

hero.heading: A compact evidence ledger for FMI work.
hero.body: This page gathers the public-facing records that help reviewers, policy staff, collaborators, and institutional readers understand what Fractal Media Infrastructure has already placed into the public record: policy submissions, scholarly identifiers, indexed papers, public software, open repositories, app releases, and public education surfaces.

footerPanel.heading: Not a pitch deck. Receipts first.
footerPanel.body: The page is intentionally compact: dates, surfaces, short theme notes, and direct evidence links. It is meant to help a busy reader see that FMI work is not confined to one repo or one claim; it spans policy, software, public education, research indexing, and open technical infrastructure.

records.title: ORCID scholarly works mirrored through public paper surfaces
records.body: Nine FMI scholarly works are currently listed on the public ORCID record. FMI treats ORCID as the structured public counter for papers that are also maintained through PhilPapers / PhilArchive-facing publication workflows, with source repositories retained for context, licensing, and public review.
